components.name: Experiment button
components.css: .ds-experiment-button { padding: .5rem .8rem; color: var(--sl-color-text); background: var(--sl-color-gray-6); border: 1px solid var(--sl-color-gray-3); border-radius: .25rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-experiment-button:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-experiment-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sl-color-text-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Experiment numeric input
components.description: Labelled numeric parameter with native bounds and validation.
components.html: <label class="ds-experiment-label">初始速度 (m/s)<input class="ds-experiment-input" type="number" min="-20" max="20" step="0.1" value="0" required></label>
components.css: .ds-experiment-label { display: grid; gap: .35rem; margin: 0; } .ds-experiment-input { width: 100%; padding: .5rem; background: var(--sl-color-bg); color: var(--sl-color-text); border: 1px solid var(--sl-color-gray-3); border-radius: .25rem; } .ds-experiment-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sl-color-text-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Preserve the native Astro/Starlight documentation interface. Chinese aerospace teaching content, English technical terms, visible equations and reproducible experiment data determine the reading experience. No separate creative metaphor or custom brand has been approved.
keyCharacteristics: Familiar documentation navigation and reading hierarchy.
Theme-aware controls integrated into the lesson.
Explicit distinction between precomputed references and local simulation results.
dos: Do inherit Starlight theme and typography for new teaching content.
Do preserve visible units, keyboard focus, status text and downloadable numerical results.
Do label precomputed and local results accurately and retain readable content when disconnected.
donts: Don't imply that parameter edits recompute a reference chart.
Don't introduce a separate brand palette or speculative component system without an approved direction.
